description: Publication host (lower-case host of the first rsync URI of an SIA) -> {rir, class, operator}. Exact host names, no patterns. A host's class applies in the warehouse of its own rir; in another RIR's warehouse its objects are 'delegated' (they are not operated by that RIR). Hosts not listed are 'delegated'; objects without a resolvable host are 'unknown'. Evidence: CA certificates whose own SIA has the host, counted over all history in the warehouse of the rir (distinct keys, first and last notBefore), read on the production warehouses 2026-10-29.

classes.rir_hosted: the RIR's hosted CA service (the RIR operates the CA and the repository)
classes.rir_paas: the RIR's publication service for CAs its members run themselves (APNIC rpki.sub.apnic.net, ARIN RPS, RIPE NCC PaaS)
classes.nir_hosted: a National Internet Registry's CA platform and repository (IDNIC, JPNIC, CNNIC, TWNIC under APNIC; NIC.br under LACNIC)

not_listed: KRNIC, VNNIC and IRINN: no CA certificate in any warehouse has an SIA host matching krnic, kisa, *.kr, vnnic, *.vn, irinn or nixi (2026-10-29); their members' CAs are on rpki.apnic.net. The only *.in hosts are repo.nkn.in and repo2.nkn.in (National Knowledge Network, 4 keys from 2026-07), a delegated CA.
NIC Mexico: no publication host of its own in warehouse-lacnic.

rpki.rand.apnic.net: APNIC R&D's own CA (two keys, 2020-03..2022-05 and 2022-11.., issued by a CA hosted on rpki.apnic.net; 3,996 signed-object EE certificates 2020-03..2026-10), not a member service: delegated.
